outcome.technical: Implemented both halves of F630's two-part fix. (1) drive-phase.py: finish() now calls a new _next_chain_phase(ctx), which re-reads the manifest fresh (after sign-off's own write) and asks _status_facts.ready_by_phase for the first phase beyond the one that just closed; when one exists, the 'done' instruction gains a new STEPS['done-chain-next'] line: 'chain: clear context, then re-enter with /audit:phase <next> for a fresh start'. This rides the existing 'do what it prints' instruction the command body (commands/phase.md step 2) already states as a hard rule, so the directive is the step, not a tip, without adding any prose to commands/phase.md itself - measure-context.py --gate showed the '/audit:phase run form, before sign-off' entry already at 3985/4000 bytes at this task's base commit, with zero slack for new prose; an earlier version of this change that added a sentence to phase.md's step 4 pushed that entry to 4118/4000 and was reverted once tools/measure-context.py --gate caught the breach (confirmed at base commit via --ref, then again on the reverted tree: GATE OK). reference/orchestrator.md (not read by the pipeline, per its own first line) documents the behaviour under a new ### subsection nested inside the existing '## Progress output' section (not a new top-level '##', which test__areas.py's anchor-coverage lint requires either an anchor or an UNANCHORED_SECTIONS row for - folding it in as a subsection avoided a scope decision on a file outside this task's files). (2) usage_ledger.py gained two new functions: main_transcript_path(session_id, home=None) - globs <home>/projects/*/<sessionId>.jsonl, no project-slug derivation needed since a session id is a UUID - and current_context_size(transcript_path) -> (tokens, model, reason), a SNAPSHOT of the most recent assistant turn's own usage (never a sum), with reason naming why when tokens is None (unreadable file, or no assistant usage yet). audit-status.py gained orchestrator_context(manifest, manifest_path, project_dir=None), which reads $CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID, resolves the transcript, calls current_context_size, and - past usage_ledger.LONG_PROMPT_THRESHOLD_TOKENS - prices one more request this size as a fresh 'in' read at the resolved pricing table (an honest no-cache upper bound) via _context_line's render. Both render_status (full) and render_short (the entry view the step driver's loop echoes) now print 'orchestrator context: <tok> tok (<model>)' or 'orchestrator context: unknown (<reason>)'; the line is entirely absent when there is no $CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID at all (ordinary runs outside a live session stay exactly as quiet as before - this is what kept the three byte-pinned sl1/sl2/sl3 cases in test_audit_status.py green, since those run through an ACTUAL live session's env in this sandbox and would otherwise have diverged between the in-process and subprocess-stripped-env paths the test compares). Tests added: test_usage_ledger.py cctx1-cctx5 (current_context_size: last-turn snapshot not a sum, unreadable file, no-usage-yet, main_transcript_path glob-by-session-id, no-match/no-session); test_audit_status.py ocx1-ocx8 (no-session is silent, unknown-with-reason when a session id resolves to no transcript, a real reading names tokens+model, render_status/render_short carry or omit the line correctly); test_drive_phase.py cn0-cn2, a new staged block registered in STAGES (cn-block) building a two-phase manifest fixture and calling M.finish() directly with release_lock/drop_state stubbed out, proving the chain line appears naming the next ready phase and is absent when nothing is ready. Full-tree python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py --jobs 6 -> 334/334 files ok, 153 migrated to tests/, 16035 cases, exit code 0 (this run also surfaced and fixed a real regression this task introduced: adding reference/orchestrator.md's new section as a top-level '## A phase boundary is a context boundary' heading tripped test__areas.py's anchor-coverage lint (oa1/oa5 failing, 121/123) because the lint requires every '## ' section to be anchored or listed in UNANCHORED_SECTIONS; fixed by nesting it as '### ...' under the existing '## Progress output' section instead, re-verified test__areas.py -> ALL PASS: 123/123, and test_audit_task.py -> ALL PASS: 1027/1027 confirming that file's earlier red under load was unrelated to this task, not reproducible standalone). I did NOT edit commands/phase.md, PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md, or usage_ledger.py's re-export lists beyond what is shown - phase.md has no byte slack for new prose under its own measured ceiling (see above), and PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md's 'new .py + tree line + section' rule only applies to a newly added .py file, which this task did not add.
outcome.descriptive: A phase chain now tells the orchestrator to clear context before the next phase, and /audit:status names the orchestrator's own current context size and, past a long prompt, what one more request would cost.
